main.description: Segments whose current name contains q, ignoring case, best match first: the whole name, then names starting with q, then names with a word starting with q, then the rest; within a match, nearest the given centre first, or by name without one. Serves the segments searchSegments would serve the viewer, never lifts. With a box, only segments whose line passes through it; a page may then hold fewer than limit, or none, with a cursor: keep paging while there is one. Only a page without a cursor ends the search.

q.description: Search text, case-insensitive. A blank query returns no segments.

minLat.description: 1e-7 degrees. The box is optional, but all four of its sides or none.

nearLat.description: 1e-7 degrees. The centre results are ordered from within a match, with nearLng or not at all.

sport.description: Only segments of this sport group.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Only some of the box's sides, or only one of nearLat and nearLng; a box with min above max, or wider than 1 degree on either side.
